pages: Acme Services Agreement. Payment terms are net thirty days from the invoice date. Late payments accrue interest at one percent per month. All invoices must reference the purchase order number.

The agreement renews annually unless either party gives sixty days written notice before the renewal date. Either party may terminate for a material breach after a thirty day written cure period. Confidential information must be protected for five years after termination.
Information Security Policy. Production access requires multi-factor authentication. Encryption at rest uses AES-256. Backups are retained for thirty-five days and are tested monthly.
Security incidents must be reported to the security team within seventy-two hours. Access reviews occur quarterly. Suspected data loss must be escalated immediately.
